description: This file contains extension methods for consuming unknown fields during deserialization in Orleans.Serialization, including methods for handling various wire types and skipping fields. It provides specialized functionality for managing unknown protocol buffer fields.

classes.name: ConsumeFieldExtension
classes.description: Provides extension methods for consuming unknown protocol buffer fields during deserialization.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Consumes an unknown field of a generic input type, handling different wire types appropriately.

methods.name: ConsumeUnknownField
methods.description: Consumes an unknown field with a scoped reference, handling wire types and possibly skipping or recording the field.

methods.name: ConsumeTagDelimitedField
methods.description: Consumes all fields within a tag-delimited field until an end object marker is found.
